title: Three Summers and One Short Crate
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：potato　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 potato 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the grower ① dug the potato that no buyer in the greenhouse would have counted, and he said the digging was the whole of the summer. The ② potato, meaning the vegetable itself and not the crate, ran three summers and stayed uncounted in the book; a potato, he said, is the only thing in a greenhouse that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ potato in that greenhouse had the same short crate beside it, and the ④ potato at the far shelf, meaning the bundle they kept for the children to tie and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A potato, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the grower said the counting is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the potato was the whole of the matter, meaning the staple and not the vegetable. The ⑥ potato, meaning the staple and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; potato, he said, is either something you dig or the only word that means both a vegetable and a staple. He said the staple is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ potato had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short crate. The ⑧ potato of the whole thing, the grower wrote in August, was one greenhouse and three summers of counting; potato, he said, is either the bundle at the far shelf or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ potato I remember is the vegetable counted in the ledger, which closed in 1998 and is still counted as the quietest in the greenhouse. A ⑩ potato, my mother said in 2000, is the only vegetable that improves by being counted; every potato, she said, is a staple that has agreed to look like a vegetable. She said the staple was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 土豆；马铃薯（指大棚里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 土豆；马铃薯（指那个土豆本身，与浅浅的木箱相对）
C. 固定搭配：dig the potato 刨这一个土豆
D. n. 土豆；马铃薯（指留给孩子们捆的那一捆）
E. n. 土豆之事（抽象总称，指一处大棚的土豆之事）
F. n. 土豆；马铃薯（指收成账里写到、被清点的那一个）
G. n. 土豆、主食（指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 主食（抽象总称，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: dug the potato that no buyer in the greenhouse would have counted
The potato, meaning the vegetable itself and not the crate
the potato at the far shelf
the potato was the whole of the matter
the potato had become a line in a ledger
The potato of the whole thing
A potato, my mother said in 2000

answers.why: dig the potato 意为“刨这一个土豆”，1991 年那位种植户把大棚里没有一位收购人肯清点的一个土豆做了一遍。
potato 意为“土豆；马铃薯”，指那个土豆本身而不是浅浅的木箱，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被清点。
potato 意为“土豆；马铃薯”，指大棚里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只浅浅的木箱。
potato 意为“土豆；马铃薯”，指最远那层架位的留给孩子们捆的那一捆，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
potato 意为“土豆、主食”，指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个主食就是那件事的全部。
potato 意为“主食”，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个土豆，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
potato 意为“土豆；马铃薯”，指收成账里写到、被清点的那一个，到 1996 年这一个成了收成账里的一行。
potato 意为“土豆之事”，种植户八月写道，整件事的土豆之事是一处大棚和三个夏天的清点。
potato 意为“土豆；马铃薯”，我记得的是收成账里清点过的那一个，1998 年收完了，至今仍被说成大棚里最安静的一个。
potato 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，土豆是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的土豆。

items: 1991 年那位种植户刨了大棚里没有一位收购人肯清点的一个土豆，他说这一遍才是那个夏天的全部。（dig the potato）
那个土豆，指的是那个土豆本身而不是浅浅的木箱，经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被清点。（potato）
那处大棚里每一个土豆旁边都有同一只浅浅的木箱。（potato）
最远那层架位那个土豆，指的是他们留给孩子们捆的那一捆，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（potato）
叔叔说这个主食就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那个土豆。（potato）
2000 年母亲说，土豆是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的土豆。（potato）
